items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He was the leader of the band... eventually you'd wind up working for him... they'd go to work with Vernon Andrade

ctx.x: Andrade. Vernon Andrade. He was the leader of the band. He stayed there for years. Yeah, Vernon Andrade, that's right.
It seems like if you hung around Harlem long enough, you'd eventually work for him.
